subject.title: Unify cron run records into the background task ledger

question: Should cron execution history become authoritative in the shared task ledger using the proposed staged migration and lifecycle convergence?
rationale: This direction changes persistent storage, migration ownership, retention defaults, configuration, recovery, cancellation, and several client-facing read paths, so implementation should wait for explicit architecture sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor staged consolidation
options.body: Approve the two-phase transition with dual-write rollback safety and explicit database, retention, lifecycle, and cross-client proof gates.

options.title: Narrow the first phase
options.body: Enrich the task mirror and evaluate ledger-backed reads while deferring table removal, config retirement, and cancellation convergence.

options.title: Retain separate history
options.body: Keep cron-specific persistence and reduce duplication only through narrower shared task lifecycle interfaces.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged consolidation
recommendation.body: Approve the two-phase transition with dual-write rollback safety and explicit database, retention, lifecycle, and cross-client proof gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal author defined the intended architecture and compatibility boundaries and is the only evidence-backed decision owner available in the supplied context.
